parameters.name: mode
parameters.label: Alignment mode
parameters.help_text: Preset that controls overall accuracy/speed trade-off. Fast and precise are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: type
parameters.label: Alignment type (--type)
parameters.help_text: Force alignment type. Leave empty for auto-detection. 'divergent' is for divergent protein sets; 'internal' is for nucleotide-like data.

parameters.name: nthreads
parameters.label: Threads (--nthreads)
parameters.help_text: Number of CPU cores to use.

parameters.name: refine
parameters.label: Refinement (--refine)
parameters.help_text: Post-alignment refinement. 'all' refines everywhere; 'confident' only refines confident regions.

parameters.name: gpo
parameters.label: Gap open penalty (--gpo)
parameters.help_text: Penalty for opening a gap. Leave empty for auto-tuned default based on input.

parameters.name: gpe
parameters.label: Gap extension penalty (--gpe)
parameters.help_text: Penalty for extending an open gap. Leave empty for default.

parameters.name: tgpe
parameters.label: Terminal gap extension penalty (--tgpe)
parameters.help_text: Penalty for extending a terminal gap. Leave empty for default.

parameters.name: consistency
parameters.label: Anchor consistency (--consistency)
parameters.help_text: Number of consistency anchors (K). Higher values increase accuracy at the cost of speed. Set to 0 to disable consistency anchoring.

parameters.name: consistency_weight
parameters.label: Consistency anchor weight (--consistency-weight)
parameters.help_text: Weight applied to consistency anchors. Higher = stronger anchoring effect.

parameters.name: realign
parameters.label: Realignment iterations (--realign)
parameters.help_text: Number of alignment-guided tree rebuild iterations. 0 = no rebuilding. Higher = potentially more accurate, slower.

parameters.name: vsm_amax
parameters.label: VSM amplitude (--vsm-amax)
parameters.help_text: VSM amplitude parameter. 0 = disabled. Leave empty for auto-tuned default.

parameters.name: adaptive_budget
parameters.label: Adaptive refinement budget (--adaptive-budget)
parameters.help_text: Scale the number of refinement trials based on alignment uncertainty.

parameters.name: ensemble
parameters.label: Ensemble runs (--ensemble)
parameters.help_text: Number of ensemble alignments to compute (0 = off). Higher = more accurate, slower.

parameters.name: ensemble_seed
parameters.label: Ensemble RNG seed (--ensemble-seed)
parameters.help_text: Random seed for ensemble reproducibility. Only used when ensemble > 0.

parameters.name: min_support
parameters.label: Ensemble consensus threshold (--min-support)
parameters.help_text: Explicit consensus threshold for ensemble alignments. Leave empty for auto. Only used when ensemble > 0.
